training.name: 知意 1.4V2-Long-L12 / Zhiyi 1.4V2-Long-L12
training.method: 1.4V2's structure with 12 of its 22 encoder layers (layers 0, 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13, 14, 19, 20, 21 kept), word choice distilled from a Qwen3.5-9B teacher (LoRA, Apache-2.0 base) in the ctx-first sequence; the continuation head distilled from a second Qwen3.5-9B teacher (LoRA) that writes the typed characters
training.data: 3.77M word-choice rows (2.89M Chinese, 0.88M English) with the IME's real candidates, typed codes and preceding text, loss 0.3 x cross-entropy to the right candidates + 0.7 x teacher KL (T 2); 4.31M composition rows (2.2M with the teacher's top-16 characters per syllable, 0.5 x T^2 soft cross-entropy + 0.5 x cross-entropy)
